name: watchdog
description: The whole Watchdog pack in one plugin: 14 security dogs (VAPT, cloud, AI, API, privacy, supply chain, auth, mobile, database and more). /watchdog-go-<area> runs one dog, /watchdog-go-all runs them all.

authScope.title: Authorized scope
authScope.description: In-scope targets you have written permission to test (hosts, packages, bundle ids). The dog refuses active testing outside this.
